built_from: out/pinakes-full/corpus (jobs/pinakes-full.yml) -> culturescrape datalog-materialize --exclude contemporary precedes follows
note: Release record for the materialised Datalog inference over the full pinakes convergence corpus, regenerated at the rules-layer US-001 benchmark (P279 class-membership closure) against the post-US-001 edge model. 'base_relations' counts the predicates the shared rules read; 'derived_relations' is the engine-free fixpoint extension of each STRUCTURAL rule (culturescrape.datalog.materialize). These TYPE counts are the DETERMINISTIC fingerprint of the derivation over this corpus; they track the live corpus, so regenerate with the command in docs/convergence-build.md 'Materialize Datalog inference at scale (US-004)' after any rebuild (datalog-materialize always attaches the committed subclass_of taxonomy -- no flag needed). The corpus and its corpus-datalog export are gitignored. NEW (rules-layer US-001): 'subclass_of' is a base relation projected from the committed Wikidata P279 taxonomy (src/culturescrape/datalog/taxonomy/subclass_of.tsv, 2 label-scoped edges: ArchaeologicalCulture<Culture, LiteraryTradition<ArtTradition). The 'instance_of' rule is the class-membership closure instance_of(X,C):-instance_of(X,D),subclass_of(D,C); its head is ALSO a base relation (the projected :LABEL facts), so its derived count is EDB union IDB -- the base :LABEL typing PLUS the ancestor memberships the taxonomy adds (an ArchaeologicalCulture entity now answers instance_of for Culture, a LiteraryTradition entity for ArtTradition). 'engine_only' lists the arithmetic temporal rules (contemporary/precedes/follows): US-001 (edge model) turned these from stored O(n^2) edges into rules over time_start/time_end, so the engine-free naive-fixpoint evaluator would recompute their ~10^6-pair span-overlap join every round -- intractable at full scale. They are validated engine-side (the CI cross-engine equivalence test over fixtures) and by the materializer over the small bundled fixture; a real swipl/souffle derives them lazily at query time. genetic_linguistic_correlation is 0 here because pinakes ships no genetics domain (no haplogroup source); the rule materialises on a merged corpus that includes one -- see the shipped genetic-linguistic-correlation example over the bundled fixture.
